archive_frequency: daily at 04:00 UTC, maximum five-minute jitter, only after destination mount and resource admission
derivative_pruning: Only deploy/reality-research.json scheduled completed example caches and unpublished builder scratch are disposable. Keep immutable manifests/code/source references and visible pruning receipts. Raw roots, accepted Gate B/C/D artifacts and protected Prometheus evidence are excluded.
offloading: Verified local archive on the allocated /dev/sda4 staging filesystem; this is a second copy, not off-host redundancy. Never delete originals automatically.
rollover: A new raw root requires an intentional collector stop, finalized verified archive, retained old-root manifest, and reviewed disk commitments. Keep the original root recoverable; new root identity/ordinals must remain distinct. No automatic rollover is configured.
on_exhaustion: Fail closed, publish FAILED status if disk permits, retain complete checksummed observations, require operator capacity action. Do not drop frames or erase observations to maintain an apparently healthy state.
headroom_basis: Separate commitments: raw budget up to 112 GiB on NVMe while preserving at least 20 GiB filesystem free; verified archive budget up to 112 GiB on /dev/sda4 while preserving 400 GiB. At the 2026-10-21 10:02 CEST snapshot, raw use was 4,907,040,971 B and NVMe free space was 177,074,360,320 B. Two active demo-mode API databases on the same NVMe totaled 8,849,743,872 B. Their 30-day high-water growth projection is separately stated in shared_service_storage. Filling the staged raw budget remains possible while retaining the 20 GiB reserve; recovery/archive temporary space is on the separate HDD. No historical files were removed.
research_priority: Collector: 512 MiB maximum, 25% of one CPU. Capacity: 128 MiB, 10% CPU. Archive: 256 MiB, 10% CPU, idle I/O and lower scheduling priority. Both operations workers are independent of collector and frontend.
limits: At the conservative 973,161,695 B/day rate, 112 GiB from the 2026-10-21 09:06 raw usage yields about 118.6 days of byte-budget runway. The configured 105-day age stop is currently about 98.1 days away; about 20.5 days of byte-budget margin remain at the baseline rate.

For a 90-day initial expansion horizon, a 1.2x current growth rate consumes about 105.1 GB of the remaining 115.4 GB raw budget, leaving about 10.3 GB of application margin. A 1.3x rate leaves only about 1.6 GB before other shared-disk writers; treat 1.2x as the prudent initial storage envelope until measured growth supports more. A 2x workload is not supported for 90 days on current NVMe capacity after preserving the reserve.
Local replication is not off-host redundancy.

The protected recorder still enforces its currently loaded 24 GiB budget and 90-day retention until an explicitly approved restart; the 112 GiB / 105-day config is pending and must be shown separately by monitoring.
No raw pruning, automatic rollover, or new collectors are configured. Sustained operation beyond the age stop requires an intentional reviewed root rollover.
Capacity monitor samples every 30 minutes; it warns at 30 days, marks critical at 14 days, and requires capacity action by 7 days without pruning raw data.
forecast_floor_basis: Historical conservative raw growth measurement; keep until at least 90 days of current production measurements support revision.

shared_service_storage.projection_basis: Short paired file-size samples; remeasure during the 90-day horizon.
